status: engineering; confirmation requires archived hash freeze
evidence_class: controlled simulation using measured numerical runtime primitives; no observed adoption or revenue
clock: one unit is the median measured build_seconds across the frozen matrix set; all displayed seconds use that one scale
forecast_target: at least one numerically qualified request delivered by absolute model time 4 clock units, also before its expiry; absent or unadopted demand is a negative event
competitor_interpretation: an available alternative that every policy may rent after arrival; its measured build cost is charged in explicitly assumed 1/64 shares. Imitation changes the alternative; it never deletes already delivered beneficiary utility
primary_comparator: one globally best credible policy selected by mean full-cost mission credits on calibration; excludes constructive_foresight and clairvoyant_menu; fixed before confirmation
policy_equivalence_control: constructive_foresight and independently enumerated adaptive_same_signal have the same observations, calibrated base-rate model, signal access, construction plans and adaptive arrival recourse. The conventional policy compiles its finite rule at training, with preparation charged, rather than repeatedly evaluating it at execution. Equality is permitted and is not a unique-policy advantage
information: All methods have frozen primitive calibration, context, time, public model and signal-purchase option. Actual demand count, arrival, adoption and the request expiry/deadline become observed together when demand arrives; current competitor availability is observable. Before arrival, future arrival/expiry/competitor times are unavailable. Sampled service durations and success uniforms remain latent until an admitted service attempt completes
model_fitting: Calibration seeds generate a finite scenario bank under announced model distributions. Conditional plan utility and event probabilities are estimated by paired replay with demand absent/present. This is model calibration, not real-world forecast calibration. No confirmation draws are used for policy or comparator selection
voi: expected best posterior plan utility after signal, including acquisition compute and delay, minus best prior plan utility; purchase only if strictly positive. Actual controller/preparation CPU is charged in reported full cost, so model-positive VOI can still lose after those costs
runtime_primitives: Measured perf_counter wall runtime samples are resampled where provided; otherwise the supplied calibrated scalar is deterministic. Cold and ready times exclude validation; cold includes its own factorization. Missing build_success_rate defaults to 1 and is an assumption
duration_information_boundary: Request admission uses frozen calibrated scalar duration estimates plus observed current time, never the future sampled duration. An admitted attempt consumes its complete sampled runtime even if it finishes late. Late qualified results are missed, late_attempts and late_numerical_wall_seconds retain their work, and failed/late subsets are not added twice. The oracle is an exact best reference over the same finite plan menu with its admission rules
time_basis: numerical_wall_seconds is measured perf_counter wall runtime replayed in the model. Controller and preparation CPU are separately measured. accounted_cost_seconds conservatively sums numerical wall, assumed signal/competitor runtime, and controller/preparation CPU at the same explicitly assumed credit rate per second; it is not metered CPU or spending. compute_seconds is a legacy alias. Controller wall time delays dispatch; actual late work remains charged
forecast_score_boundary: wait_and_act and adaptive_nonforecast receive only shared OFFLINE evaluator estimates after their decision timer; these are labeled offline_shared_evaluator_only and excluded from policy calibration charts. Their evaluator CPU is study overhead and is reported separately. The clairvoyant is excluded too. Only model-using policies claim their own policy-conditional forecasts and are charged model preparation
preparation_accounting: The measured full model-fitting CPU cost is allocated to each deployed model-using policy over the declared 4608 confirmation episodes. This is the cost for a hypothetical independently deployed policy, not a division of a shared free model. Engineering labor/inference remain in the separate study ledger
stress_information_boundary: Delayed adoption/arrival and reversed signal likelihood are unannounced changes at confirmation. Calibration for these regimes uses the announced nominal arrival/adoption/likelihood, so test outcomes cannot leak into the forecast model
uncertainty: Paired common-random-number counterfactuals; primary confidence intervals resample complete seed blocks, preserving all 32 episodes and matrix contexts per seed. Intervals describe Monte Carlo variation under the stated model only
stopping_rule: exactly the declared seeds and episodes; no success-dependent repetitions or removal of adverse episodes; invalid primitive inputs stop the run
clairvoyant_boundary: Exact best outcome among the common finite plan menu plus build-at-demand, with future event draws revealed and zero ideal dispatch delay; oracle_menu_bound_credits is this model upper reference. Its measured search CPU is separately charged in mission_credits. It is excluded from calibration plots and deployable comparator selection
outputs: compressed complete episode-policy CSV, block means, calibration bins, fixed-comparator paired bootstrap intervals, native outcome/cost columns, policy disagreement, per-regime loss/harm counts, input/code hashes and modeled assumptions
